name: Subec Tag
summary:
Subec Tag takes everything you love about Gorilla Tag and cranks it up. Jump, climb, and wall-bounce your way through custom maps with friends or strangers, all while mastering fast-paced, legless movement. Whether you're outsmarting chasers in tag mode or just messing around in lobbies, Subec Tag is about freedom, skill, and pure VR fun.
Get ready to sweat, and scream—it’s all part of the game.
